notes.title: Demo Update & Full version Pre-Release Trailer
notes.content: [p][b]Happy-Happy![/b][/p][p][b]"As progress progresses" also the Journey to The Lost Waterpark is making progress :)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to feedback from our localization experts, our play testers and also content creators on Youtube and Twitch we were able to make even more adjustments, apply changes and did also fix bugs that must have lived inside microscopic spaces.[/p][p][/p][p][u]In short[/u]: A more polished out demo version is now available to you :) You'll find the changelog and all its previous updates in the changelog channel on our discord, linked here below.[/p][p][/p][p][u]On top of that:[/u] Please enjoy our [b]new pre-release trailer video[/b] on the steam store page showcasing some of what is to be expected in the full version of J2LWP :)[/p][p][/p][p][u]In any way[/u]: Make sure you hop on board the steam forums, our discord or any other place where you would want to let us know about your opinion. Feedback is important and that's why we are counting on our growing community :)[/p][p][/p][p]Make sure to Ride and Slide & Stay Safe![/p]

notes.title: Stage clear for the DEMO!
notes.content: [p]Serving as an alternate prologue to the full version, we are excited to bring to you the enthralling Demo version of Journey to the Center of the Lost Waterpark![/p][p][/p][p]Big thanks goes to the playtesters of the demo version who were providing numerous feedback and valuable input for making necessary adjustments, improvents and eliminating bugs and other unwanted behaviour. Namely they are Scott aka Not Sure (J2LWP Lead Tester), ttv/KokuenDono, caliber and YT/They_Call_Me_X.[/p][p][/p][p][b]So with no further ado[/b]: Ready yourselves for a unique liminal and poolrooms experience, where top notch high quality sound effects and music accompany you.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3836620/Journey_To_The_Center_Of_The_Lost_Waterpark_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you want to share your demo experience, we are interested in reading your opinion. To share your feedback feel free to use the steam forums, the steam page's demo review section and/or make your voice heard on our [url="https://discord.gg/NCuQEf5SGq"]discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Dive In & Have Fun![/p][p]Your team of Cosmic Disintegration Games[/p]

notes.title: It's a Journey!
notes.content: [p]It's a Journey![/p][p][/p][p][b]A journey like no other indeed[/b]. Cosmic Disintegration Games is proud to announce to you that we are NOW live with our store page.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A journey like no other[/b] that is in the making for several months, play-tested by wholeheartedly testers native to the Poolrooms genre and will be available in your homes soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Cosmic Disintegration Games consists of 2 people, which is for one me, Chris, the founder, designer, programmer - and as far as my skills take me - also graphics designer, but for another also SXaiRenDD as head of sound design.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Transparency[/b] is an important topic to us which is why we let you know right away that Journey to the Center of the Lost Waterpark (short: J2LWP) is a game designed in Unreal Engine 5. Performance optimization is also important to us (who would have guessed :D), so we try our best in terms of knowledge to improve what's there to improve while giving you graphics options to adjust all the single thingies, such as resolution scale, Anti-Aliasing methods and many more.[/p][p][/p][p]For this first and - to us important - announcement, we like to close things off with:[/p][list][*][p]Feel free to join [b]our discord[/b] at: [url="https://discord.gg/NCuQEf5SGq"]https://discord.gg/NCuQEf5SGq[/url][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]demo will be ready soon[/b]. As soon as working on the demo level is finished because the demo level will NOT contain levels of the full version. It is supposed to be a separate experience, showcasing the features of the full version[/p][/*][*][p]For [b]Localization[/b] we currently have English, German, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese localization in the game. If you want to help with localizing the game to languages you are not only fluent in but love and respect the languages your are fluent in, top-notching actual [b]localization [/b](not just "translation"), feel free to get in touch with me, Chris, on the discord. The reward will be a free full version game key next to getting access to the branches our beloved testers use.[/p][/*][*][p]Feel free [b]to reach out[/b] to Cosmic Disintegration Games if you have any questions. Either by using the steam forums or by getting in touch with the community on our discord. If you want to interview us, we are also open for that.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for having us, the team of Cosmic Disintegration Games.[/p][p]We would love to see you hopping onto this journey with us.[/p][p]And if you like what you see we are happy if you like to wishlist our game :)[/p][p][/p][p]Best wishes & Good Journey,[/p][p]Your team of Cosmic Disintegration Games[/p]
